{{Quote|As a Jedi I was taught to preserve life. I led these clones&mdash;no, these men&mdash;to their deaths. These were living, sentient beings.|Jedi Master K'Kruhk|<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu" />}}
The '''416th Star Corps''' was a [[Corps/Legends|corps]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], that served under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[K'Kruhk]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Towards the start of the war, the 416th's [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] participated in the [[Battle of Teyr]], which led to the corps suffering heavy casualties. Due to having led so many troopers to their [[Death/Legends|deaths]], the corps' [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] disappeared following the battle's conclusion.

==Description==
[[File:ISP_KKruhk_TCWCG.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Jedi General K'Kruhk leaps off of a 416th swamp speeder.]]
The 416th Star Corps was a [[Corps/Legends|corps]] of<ref name="TCWCG" /> 36,864 [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], along with support personnel, that served in one of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Armies]].<ref name="Composition" /> 

Under the leadership of the<ref name="TCWCG" /> [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]]<ref name="Whiphid">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[K'Kruhk]]<ref name="TCWCG" /> and a [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|clone marshal commander]],<ref name="Leadership" /> the 416th had four [[Brigade/Legends|brigades]] under its command,<ref name="Composition" /> including a [[Seven-One's battalion|battalion]]<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu" /> that was led by [[Clone battalion commander|Clone Battalion Commander]] [[CRC-09/571|Seven-One]].<ref name="Shatterpoint" /> The corps' [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] wore standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor]] and wielded the [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]].<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu" /> In addition, the corps used at least one [[Infantry Support Platform/Legends|Infantry Support Platform]] [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]].<ref name="TCWCG" />

==History==
===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|When the call came after Geonosis, I obeyed. [&hellip;] I led them into battle. I lead from the front, not from behind. I know no other way.|Jedi General K'kruhk, on taking command of the 416th Star Corps.|<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu" />}}
Following the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the 416th Star Corps was placed under command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] K'Kruhk during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an [[Galaxy/Legends|inter-galactic]] war between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. At one point during the war, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leaped off of one of the 416th's [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] speeders, [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by two clone troopers, while having [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Color/Legends|green-bladed]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] ignited.<ref name="TCWCG" />

====Battle of Teyr====
{{Quote|We can achieve the objective, general. We need to press on.''"<br />"''Most of you will die in the process. That is not acceptable to me.''"<br />"''With respect, sir&mdash;it is what we were bred for. To battle, to obey, and to die, if need be. That's all.|One of the 416th's clone troopers and Jedi General K'kruhk.|<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu" />}}
In 22 BBY, the 416th Star Corps participated in the [[Battle of Teyr]],<ref name="TCWCG" /> a battle that was fought against the Confederacy's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces on the<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu" /> [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Teyr">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Teyr]].<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu" /> 

[[File:KKruhkTeyr.jpg|thumb|right|350px|The 416th fought during the Battle of Teyr, which resulted in the death of many of the corps' clone troopers.]]
Leading his forces from the front, including one of the 416th's battalions, the Whiphid [[General/Legends|General]] eventually considered calling off the battle and retreating in order to save the lives of his men, as the battle had turned for the worst. However, K'Kruhk chose to keep fighting instead after a [[Unidentified clone trooper (Teyr)|clone trooper]] convinced him to stay. The clone trooper stated that they could still achieve the mission's objectives, as their lives were unimportant in the greater scheme of things and could be sacrificed for the Galactic Republic's victory on the planet.<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu" /> 

Despite K'Kruhk's best efforts, heavy casualties still occurred under the Jedi General's command. As a result of his actions, and the conflicting ideologies of leading [[Species/Legends|living beings]] to their deaths as a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], who was supposed to preserve life, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] K'Kruhk disappeared without a trace after the battle's conclusion. Reappearing later in the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], for a meeting with other Jedi distraught with the war on the Outer Rim [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ruul (moon)|Ruul]], K'Kruhk told Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] about his conflicting ideologies towards the war and the Jedi Order, his experience on Teyr, and his leadership of the 416th Star Corps.<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 416th Star Corps first appeared, albeit unnamed, in ''[[Jedi: Mace Windu]]'', a [[2003]] comic book written by [[John Ostrander]].<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu" /> The corps was later identified in the [[2009]] ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'', a hardcover supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Saga Edition|''Star Wars Saga Edition'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="TCWCG" />
